name: Separator
description:
Structural horizontal or vertical divider bound to Surfaces/Border.

Variants: Direction = Horizontal | Vertical.
Design rules: Use sparingly to separate distinct logical groups inside Card, Sheet, Sidebar, Dialog, or Topbar.

whenToUse: Use to visually divide logical groups inside `Card`, `Sheet`, `Calendar`, `DropdownMenu`, `SidebarNavigation`, or `Topbar` (`Horizontal` or `Vertical`).
whenNotToUse: Do not insert dividers between every row or field when Quick v1.2 spacing tokens (`spacing/*`) already establish clean hierarchy.

behaviorRules: Render `<hr>` or `role="separator"` with `aria-orientation="vertical"` for vertical dividers, marking purely decorative dividers with `role="none"`.
